settings.heading: Our story
settings.body:
Dimohe brings Indian block-printed textiles, hand embroidery, and everyday essentials to the United States.

Our collection moves from the home to the wardrobe: block-printed cushions and table linens, Chikankari and Zardozi bags, children’s occasionwear, and hair and body care.

The details are the reason we choose these pieces. Gulnaar’s red-and-ivory piping. A line of cypress trees on quilted cotton. The stitched vines across Noor Bagh’s raw silk. We want you to be able to see those details, understand how a piece is made, and decide where it fits in your life.

You don’t need a whole new room or a special occasion. Start with the piece you like.
